comment: The voice demonstrated on decklight.io. The audio is NOT in this repository: it is one release asset (`site-voices`, voices.tar.gz) that the site deploy pulls into site/voices/ (gitignored), re-voices where the deck's notes changed, checks, and pushes back. tools/site-voices.mjs is the command, pull | refresh | check | push; the workflow is .github/workflows/publish-site.yml. The engine is ElevenLabs, which takes direction from the tags in the notes ([pause], [chuckles]) rather than a style prompt; the key is secrets.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
